outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs (nuclear, cytosolic, mitochondrial fraction quantifications) showing mean ± SD with N=4 mice, but only bars and error bars are shown — no individual data points (dots) are overlaid to show the underlying replicate values.
Panel B is an immunoelectron micrograph, not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot image comparing purification methods; it contains no averaged plot data requiring individual points.
Panel D is a western blot showing proteinase K protection results; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check is not applicable.
